dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: We meet again, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: What a rare opportunity to meet with you here in Liyue during this finest of festivals, as busy as you are on your travels.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite! How are you celebrating?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: As you can see, I'm ambling the streets at my leisure, enjoying the sound of people chattering and birds chirping.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor has been somewhat idle as of late, so I am presently unoccupied.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: When the director is out visiting friends, I take the opportunities to head out myself. Habit dictates that my first port of call is here, where I order myself a pot of tea, and listen to the storyteller.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: At festival times, the storyteller will always select a few new passages that complement the spirit of the season.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Most are variations on existing legends or accounts from folk history. Their historicity is questionable at times, but it is their entertainment value that makes them an excellent choice for the festive period.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I know exactly what you mean.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Hahaha, then it seems you are becoming rather familiar with the storyteller at this establishment.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Time marches forward relentlessly... People change, traditions change...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Lantern Rite is no exception.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: In times of old, Liyue was constantly at war. People lit lanterns and sent them into the sky to help guide the warriors on the distant front back to their home.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Today, we live in a time of peace, and the custom of releasing lanterns has become ceremonial in nature. For the people of Liyue, the ritual of lighting lanterns every year symbolizes the undying spirit of heroism.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The things that refuse to be shaken by the passage of time... those are Liyue's roots.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Traveler, I hope that you are able to celebrate the Lantern Rite together with the people of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about you? Do you have any plans?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Plans... not a notion that can be easily applied to me anymore. I am a man of leisure. I simply go wherever I am inclined, wherever that may be.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Although, now that you mention it... Yes, I should make the most of this festive period by venturing to parts of Liyue that lie beyond the harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I began with tea at Third-Round Knockout today... perhaps tomorrow I shall try somewhere else in the near vicinity.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It is quite a joy to be idle and explore this bustling city at my leisure.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Oh? You're here.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I do apologize, another matter was occupying my mind just now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you looking at?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Hanfeng's Ironmongers has a long history. Ownership has been passed down from generation to generation, and today it is known as the most reputable blacksmith in the land.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The art of forging prizes precision and diligence. The tasks of forging weapons and processing ore require a great deal of time and patience.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: To most, the sound of iron being struck with a hammer is loud and intrusive. But to those who appreciate this art form, it is like the toll of a bell. Breathtaking, and transfixing.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The sound of metal clashing with metal causes one to fall quiet, calms one's spirit, focuses one's attention, and then, with a mind emptied of unwanted thoughts, devote oneself fully to the work at hand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It sounds like you are talented at forging, too.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Any talent I possess comes not from natural inclination, but out of necessity. In times of war, weapons are indispensable equipment, and highly sought after.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The wondrous ley lines of Liyue produce all manner of exquisite ore. It follows naturally that distinguished artisans and prized wares arise in response.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: But I have always thought that a craftsman's ingenuity is far more valuable than any precious stone. The most accomplished in their craft do not limit themselves to working exclusively with rare ores.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about famous Liyue craftspeople.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Well, Traveler... After your long sojourn in Liyue, I trust you will have heard of the houses of Kun and Yun?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The house of Kun is a long-established name in the art of forging. To this day, their descendants continue their craft.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The house of Yun did not limit themselves to this craft. They branched out into many different disciplines and districts. Their descendants today still uphold the work ethic taught within their family for generations: "Even ostensible perfection can oft be improved upon through diligence." This has contributed towards their excellence in numerous fields.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait... Is this the same "Yun" as in "Yun Jin"?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Ah, so you are acquainted with Miss Yun. Yes, the talented Yun Jin of Liyue operatic fame is indeed a descendant of the historic house of Yun.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Her ancestors changed professions long ago. It was her father's generation that dedicated themselves to the performing arts. In this day and age, the Yun family's history has been forgotten, and nobody knows of the connection they once had to the art of forging.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The evolution of families over the ages has been a profound force in shaping Liyue's history. While you're here, if you have the time, you may find learning about the human history of Liyue to be illuminating.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It seems I still have a lot to learn.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Much that you might want to know can be found in books.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Even books change over the generations, causing discrepancies between their contents and the historical facts. But books can function as a mirror for humanity. Reading is the noblest of pastimes — there is always some benefit to be derived.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Ah, I wondered if I might run into you again. This makes the third day in a row... perhaps it is fate rather than coincidence.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you doing some reading?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Yes. After our conversation yesterday, I thought I might visit the bookhouse and see what constitutes popular literature these days.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's a lot of books in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Indeed. Traveler, do you know anything of the origins of books in Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: First, people ground wood into pulp to make paper. For ease of reading, they began binding sheets together to make what we now call "books."

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Later, they developed movable-type printing to improve the speed and quality of production. Eventually, the technology developed to the point where books like those we see here can easily be produced in great quantities.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: There has been a proliferation of literary genres and works since that time.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Traveler, is there any book from Liyue that has made a particularly strong impression on you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's a series called "Rex Incognito."

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Oh? So, you've read it too.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The author does not lack for ideas. Sometimes, they move in strange directions, and even I cannot claim to fully understand their meaning. But it makes for fresh and interesting reading material, a lot like reading somebody else's biography.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Gods and adepti are far removed from the mortal experience. That they are difficult to portray in writing is no surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It is true that the Geo Archon, Morax would journey in the mortal realm from time to time. But there was not quite so much ostentatious shapeshifting as the books would have you believe.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: When the goal is to wander the streets undetected, donning an overly elaborate disguise is somewhat self-defeating.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Such discrepancies illustrate the difference between history as it happened and folk accounts based on hearsay. The value of reading accounts penned by others is in the chance to view the world through their eyes. It is very often an unfamiliar sight, though never an uninteresting one.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've also read one called "Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti."

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. A memorable work indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I have heard that this is an unpopular book due to its often impenetrable prose. And yet, the yakshas described in it are real historical figures.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: They were loyal servants of Liyue. They lived through a bitter war and sacrificed much. All of Liyue, from harbor to chasm, is indebted to the yakshas for their protection over the years.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I believe you have seen one of these yakshas in the flesh.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Xiao.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Yes... These days, he often appears at Dihua Marsh.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: He is given to solitude. But I suspect that he would not turn away a reliable companion such as yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Should you happen to see him, please pass on my season's greetings.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: "Where the clear blue water runs into the sky, and an ocean of silvergrass stretches out before the eye." That was written about Dihua Marsh.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you enjoying the view?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: From an altitude, the sight of reeds on the water, rustling gently in the breeze, is indeed a sight beautiful beyond compare.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Wangshu Inn is located in the heart of Dihua Marsh, and provides the finest in both food and scenery. It is no wonder that travelers are fond of staying here.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: But Wangshu Inn is no mere guesthouse.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It was built tall to provide superior visibility for surveying the surrounding terrain. And it was built here, on this road, because it is one of the main routes for traffic into the region.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: This is a strategic location that must be defended at all costs.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No wonder Xiao is here so often.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Yes. That is one of the primary reasons that he frequents the inn.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Looking southeast from here, one can see all the way to Guyun Stone Forest.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: With gods lying sealed beneath those rocks, the area is frequently afflicted with monster activity. Xiao often goes back and forth between here and Guyun.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Being constantly on the move must be tiring for him. My purpose in coming here was to give him a few words of comfort, but to my surprise, I did not find him on the roof...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He must be busy with his duties.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Perhaps so. Nevertheless, this trip was by no means a waste. Besides, there shall be no shortage of opportunities to meet in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: On the subject of Wangshu Inn, the chef here is highly talented.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: If I recall correctly, there was a cooking competition hosted in Liyue Harbor during the Moonchase Festival. This chef was selected to represent the Dihua Marsh region, entered the finals, and took second prize.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Culinary excellence should always be shared far and wide.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Hmm... Being up so high reminds me of another lofty location.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Yes... one that the adepti once took control of, long ago. It then fell into disuse. Whether anyone tends to it these days, I do not know...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Alright then. That is where I shall go tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Here above the clouds, where the moon sets and the sun rises before your eyes, one's sense of time becomes indistinct.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is Cloud Retainer's place, right?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: You have encountered her several times, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She is quite wondrous, even for an adeptus.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: You possess a wealth of knowledge and experience, and you have goodness in your heart. Naturally, you are able to have friendly interactions with her.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Cloud Retainer is an expert in the mechanical arts, and an avid inventor.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Generous and kind, honest and forthright... I treasure her as both a friend and teacher, the likes of whom are hard to come by.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: An old friend once said to me that if you ever have a question on the most trivial of affairs, two hours conversing with Cloud Retainer will leave you better informed than three days and nights talking to every soul in the harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Traveler, would you say you agree?

choices.text: Hit the nail on the head.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Hahaha. Yes, Cloud Retainer does not waste words, but this is no bad thing. She may say that she prefers to keep her distance from the mortal realm, but in fact she cares deeply for humanity.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Ahh... I believe I have gazed at the mountains long enough. Time for a change of scenery.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Tomorrow... yes, perhaps I will head further north.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Qingce Village is one of the more populated places outside of the harbor. I think I shall go there.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Compared to the constant hubbub of Liyue Harbor, it is far more serene here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yep, it's so quiet here.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It is a pleasant and leisurely atmosphere, not unfit for a festival.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: On the way over, I saw grandparents preparing meals, children learning to make Xiao Lanterns... It was quite nostalgic for me. It took me back to the very earliest days of Liyue's history.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Back then, most able-bodied adults were busy supporting the war effort or helping to build the city. Like now, the oldest and youngest supported each other, living humble lives.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It sounds like they had it rough...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Indeed, their lives were not easy. But the people of Liyue have tenacity and optimism in their bones.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: They will never stop striving for progress, no matter how much destitution they face.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: In ancient times, Qingce Village was once ravaged by the Chi. It is now several thousand years since it was put to rest.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Over the millennia, people built dwellings and worked the fertile land, creating the spectacular view we now see today.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard a story about the Chi's corpse...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: ...That after it died, its body became the rocky mountains and flowing waters of Qingce. I, too, have heard this story.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The idea is captivating. Though, I'm afraid, it is pure fantasy.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Lofty mountains have stood and spring water has flowed here since time immemorial. That people now inhabit this place is solely because they have toiled to make it so.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Qingce's verdant hills and stunning waters paired with the tranquil atmosphere here make it a place of extraordinary beauty. A rare blessing indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Oh, one of the villagers generously gifted me with some fresh Bamboo Shoots. They will add some seasonal flavor to a meal on my return to Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Seasonal bamboo shoots are yet another rare blessing offered by Qingce Village.
